about: Answer key for the catalog check (core/src/keepa/verify.ts) on the recorded Keepa products. Each row: a product of fixtures/keepa/search-RYOBI-PCL235B.json checked against the part a lookup of that model would ask for (brand RYOBI unless said), labelled by reading the title against the model only, never from the check's output. is: the listing is that part, new and alone (a kit when the part is the kit); not: it is another product; uncertain: the title does not settle it. isKit is what the scan would know (classify.ts wantedFor with no catalog entry: RYOBI parts are not known kits).
